items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: Pooleys got behind me one night.

ctx.x: I got out running a spidery with me. I knew I could run. Anytime I reached up and got my big apple off my head, I was gone. You couldn't catch me with a hound dog. Turn them callers doing 90 miles? No, turn them callers. Fell down with a bottle of milk in my hand one night. Pooleys got behind me one night. Fell down, broke the bottle. I stood there and had half of my hand. Went up there and started having the milk bottle. Quarter of milk.
I was just chasing you. I had a hard time. I was coming up.
